description: GLUCOSE - An Integrated Assessment Model (IAM) for the Masses is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by KTH Royal Institute of Technology. education and communication: shows how combined cross-sectoral policies are beneficial for all resources. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: IAM. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
